evidence_class: Static: source-graph inspection only; no build, test, candidate replay, or numerical execution

reviewed_source.moving_source_limit: Stage1 changed after the reviewed read. Findings are attributable to the recorded 2e9e3ecb source; the closing c49f5883 bytes were not reviewed. The other two reviewed files remained byte-identical at close.

findings.finding: Existing evaluator and trial counters do not observe every phase-selection path. The single phase_join_selections helper is called directly by adapter evaluation, adapter select_phase, and the older controller path; adapter select_phase does not increment trial_entries.
findings.required_correction: Add one test-only counter at the actual phase_join_selections entry and compare its before/after value, or omit the runtime phase-nonentry claim. Do not infer phase calls from trial_entries.

findings.finding: A selected-field activity snapshot is not a full activity snapshot and currently omits predictor_assemblies and other observable fields.
findings.required_correction: Compare the complete M1LoopActivityObservation before and after. Preserve and restore predecessor state only after recording the after snapshot.

findings.finding: Presence plus coordinate bits is not the complete owner binding, and replacing None with live-state bits fabricates a binding value.
findings.required_correction: Retain and compare the actual Option owner binding, including input custody when Some. Preserve None exactly; do not use unwrap_or with unrelated live-state bits.

supported_corrections.basis: The sole accepted-owner capture write is m1_coupled.rs:2317-2321 inside materialize_m1_coupled_column; materialization activity increments at m1_coupled.rs:2185 before that write.
supported_corrections.disposition: Remove fabricated receipt_updates. Complete materialization activity plus exact owner-binding equality covers this path; no separate receipt counter is required.

supported_corrections.basis: frozen_weighted_merit is the shared merit entry used by the controller.
supported_corrections.disposition: A test-only counter at frozen_weighted_merit entry, compared before/after with predecessor restoration after observation, is direct and sufficient.
After the direct phase and merit counters and complete snapshots exist, fabricated phase_calls, receipt_updates, owner_publications, and empty hook-log claims may be removed.

residual_risk: Final review must verify RAII restoration on success and every refusal path, actual full-value comparisons, and source stability. This review does not approve the implementation body or runtime evidence.
